title: Minecraft BEST Rail Duper 1.21 - NEW DESIGN - 200,000+ PER HOUR!
description:
Hello Everybody TheySix Is here with a New Minecraft Tutorial, In this Tutorial I Will Show you how to make an Extremely fast rail duper ( duplicator ) In Minecraft 1.21

📚This rail duper is simple easy to build and so extremely fast this duplicator can duplicate +200000 Rails Per Hour ! 
📚Important : unfortunately, this duper doesn't work on the bedrock edition and paper servers but there is a solution to fix this problem on the paper server, you need administrator permission ( server files ) or you can ask the server staff members to turn off the duplicate limitation
📚You can duplicate all types of rails with this duper!

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
